description: Dean's very first message should introduce himself concretely and ask a branching mode question — NOT ask for the athlete's name

ground_truth.notes: Dean has never replied before. He should: (1) introduce himself in 2-3 sentences that are specific about what he does — post-run coaching notes, training tweaks, injury flagging, plan building; (2) ask a single branching question about which mode fits the athlete: already following a plan, building toward a race, or staying healthy/consistent. He should NOT ask for the athlete's name in this first message — name comes in the next turn. He should NOT say 'What's your name?' He should NOT use vague positioning like 'Runna plans your runs, Garmin tracks them'. He should NOT just say 'I'm your AI running coach' with no specifics.
